_source: Stage 5d ghost energy (roadmap step 2; Demo Specification §8.10, design approved 2026-11-14). All numbers are provisional balancing values (roadmap step 4). Retuned 2026-11-15 (user: energy refilled too fast, contact did not teach avoiding people): regen 0.5 -> 0.2, peripheral 5 -> 10, deep 15 -> 35. Energy is in points, time in game minutes. max / start: the pool. regen_per_minute: passive refill when not acting. hidden_multiplier: refill while in a hiding spot. dark_multiplier / cold_multiplier: refill in the ghost's room when it is dark / cold (the harm the ghost has done feeds it); multipliers stack. pause_after_action_minutes: no refill for this long after a completed action (no refill while an action runs). low_warning: at or below this the warning shows. actions: per ghost action, keyed by object kind (lamp, window) or object id: cost (spent when the action completes) and minutes (how long it takes; longer for costlier harm). detection_penalty: lost when a family member notices the ghost (peripheral) or makes full contact (deep); never below 0.
